projects.name: FlowAR-BRep (accepted at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
projects.summary: Single-stage generative framework for CAD B-Rep jointly modeling discrete topology and continuous parametric geometry in one Transformer (Transfusion + Flow Matching); FSM-constrained decoding, sequence packing on 4x RTX 5090, multimodal conditioning, SOTA with ~2.8x inference speedup.

projects.name: VeriCAD-RL
projects.summary: Verifiable RL fine-tuning (Qwen3-VL-2B + GRPO via ms-swift) for multi-view image-to-CAD program generation with a CadQuery verifier; success 80.14%->88.75%, Mean IoU 0.521->0.628.

projects.name: GME — Geometric Modeling Engine
projects.summary: High-performance watertight discretization for complex B-Rep (multi-university project); ~2.3x ACIS on partner test sets, deployed in industry.
